responsibility: Declares TokenTreeDesugar, the small AST visitor used to normalize macro-input token trees before parsing. It exposes the entry point that accepts a DelimTokenTree and produces a rewritten one, and defines the visitor/append interface that supports the module’s specific desugaring task of converting doc-comment tokens into attribute-form token trees while preserving other tokens.
same_name_distinction: Header counterpart to rust-token-tree-desugar.cc: it declares the TokenTreeDesugar visitor and its append/go interface for macro-input normalization, but the actual doc-comment-to-attribute rewriting logic lives in the .cc file.
